create_dt_accessor_datetime: create a .dt accessor on a Series of datetime64 values to extract properties like day, month, year
create_dt_accessor_timedelta: create a .dt accessor on a Series of timedelta64 values to extract components like days, hours, minutes
create_dt_accessor_period: create a .dt accessor on a Series of period values to extract properties like year, quarter, hour
create_dt_accessor_arrow: create a .dt accessor on a Series with Arrow datetime/timedelta dtype to extract datetime properties
test_dt_isocalendar: test the dt.isocalendar method to calculate ISO year, week, and day from a datetime Series
test_dt_components: test the dt.components property to return a DataFrame of timedelta component values
test_dt_to_pydatetime: test the dt.to_pydatetime method to convert datetime Series values to Python datetime objects
test_dt_to_pytimedelta: test the dt.to_pytimedelta method to convert timedelta Series values to Python timedelta objects
test_dt_freq: test the dt.freq property to infer the frequency of a datetime or timedelta Series
test_dt_accessor_categorical: test the .dt accessor on a Categorical Series with datetime-like categories
